verdict.rationale: The repo ships first-party, dependency-free Python command-line tools. They search the 1,400+ logo reference library from the command line, audit SVGs, generate test sheets and boards, export favicon sets, and package the skill (python3 tools/package_skill.py). These are loose scripts the agent calls, not a packaged, documented CLI product, and the /plugin commands belong to the host agent rather than the skill. Missing for 10: a unified, installable official CLI binary or entry point, a CLI command reference, and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
